lineage: V12 Ranch device/follower visual animation replacement; V11 terrain and background contracts retained. Actual Unity project integration remains unverified.
groundConnectivity: Shared full8-neighbor ALL G/W/S occupancy for every top. No internal cap or border at material changes.

undersideRules.grouping: maximal horizontal south-exposed runs, split by material and exterior/hole class
undersideRules.shortRuns: 1..4 cells receive one fused source-art body
undersideRules.longGrassRuns: length>4: deterministic1..3cell hanging bodies,1..2cell intervals, plus an unbroken shallow collar
undersideRules.longBridgeRuns: length>4: contiguous2..4cell structural spans, no gaps
undersideRules.seedAndOrigin: stable world coordinates and seed; pass the full map

renderOrder: sky base and independent background sprites: Background layer, orders -100..-20
new low turf and props sorted by ground contact
legacyGrassUse: The previous broad-leaf decor is retained for compatibility only; use decor/turf for ordinary grass.
fullCellSizing: CommonPPU256, scale1. Props use declared integer footprint and measured alpha bounds. Sprite padding is not counted as occupancy. Objects with upper overhang use custom pivot at logical footprint center.

background.defaultMode: Uniform camera cover for the clean sky base only. Independent stars/clouds use authored Z, scales and the background rig.
